propositions: GitHub Actions run logs and metadata are only retained for a short window; coverage and CI-health metrics must be harvested into a durable, git-tracked snapshot store to preserve historical trends.

The GHA harvester adapter must parse coverage from the pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tails and compute CI-health metrics (status, duration, red-to-green recovery intervals, recheck/flake rates) from run metadata, then persist them as labeled snapshots.

The core metrics command must remain isolated from the GHA adapter and never import it; CI workflows must not be modified to commit snapshots (due to read-only permissions and ephemeral checkouts), so harvesting must occur offline via a maintainer-run script.
Snapshots must be written to the git-tracked `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` store, not to the gitignored `reports/` directory, and must carry appropriate source labels.
